statement.notes: 1. 'Sales revenue' is mapped to total_revenue. 2. total_operating_cost includes Cost of sales, Distribution expenses, Administrative expenses, and Other operating expenses. 'Other operating income' (14,974 in 2024) is not included in total_operating_cost as it is a positive income item that would offset costs; standard practice is to include only expenses/costs in this field. 3. 'Earnings after tax' is mapped to net_income. 4. 'Income tax income/expense' is mapped to taxes. The sign convention is followed: the tax expense reduces income, so the positive number from the statement (4,411) is used. 5. 'Interest expenses' is mapped to interest_expenses. The sign convention is followed: the expense reduces income, so the positive number from the statement (3,446) is used. 6. All numbers are in € million, so scale is 1E6. 7. The supplementary tables provide detailed breakdowns, but the mapping uses the primary statement line items as they directly correspond to the required fields.
